section_summary: This section contains General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers (SCAP) circulars and regulations governing the entry, legal status, business activities, and property and cargo controls of commercial entrants and foreign nationals in occupied Japan, along with international postal service procedures. It also contains correspondence, travel applications, telegrams, and action slips administered by the State Department's Division of Protective Services and the Pacific Military Permit Branch concerning travel clearances and military permits for commercial representatives, religious workers, and individuals seeking compassionate entry or repatriation. Major individual cases include the repatriation of Brazilian nationals Hilde Sudhaus Wiebke and her son from Dairen, trade entry permits for American, Iranian, and European businessmen, and travel requests for persons returning to or transiting Japan.

subfiles.about: Establishes regulations governing the entry, legal status, prohibited activities, logistics, and administrative procedures for commercial entrants visiting Japan.
subfiles.from: General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: This circular defines the legal status and restrictions applicable to commercial entrants in Japan, emphasizing compliance with SCAP directives, Japanese civil law, and currency controls. It outlines logistic support provisions including Japanese-operated commercial hotels, transportation privileges, and communication services while prohibiting access to occupation force facilities and postal services. Additionally, it details the respective responsibilities of GHQ SCAP and the Commanding General of the Eighth Army regarding clearances, customs, registration, and medical inspections.
subfiles.title: SCAP Circular No. 1: Commercial Entrants

subfiles.about: Establishes regulations and conditions governing foreign business and investment activities, property acquisitions, and currency transactions in occupied Japan.
subfiles.from: General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Sets regulations for non-Japanese nationals and foreign firms conducting business, acquiring property, and investing in Japan under occupation authorities.
subfiles.title: SCAP Circular No. 2: Foreign Business and Investment Activities in Japan

subfiles.about: Prescribes comprehensive regulations governing the import and export of property, cargo, personal effects, and commercial merchandise into and out of Japan.
subfiles.from: General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: This circular establishes detailed procedures for controlling all property and cargo entering or leaving Japan, defining categories of personnel, occupation cargo, and authorized personal effects. It prescribes required import and export licenses, designates inspection authority under the Eighth Army, and lists strictly prohibited items including weapons, propaganda, narcotics, and precious metals. It also defines provisions for appeals, the seizure of unauthorized items, and property disposal under the Civil Property Custodian.
subfiles.title: SCAP Circular No. 21: Control of Entry and Exit of Property and Cargo Into and From Japan

subfiles.about: Sets forth regulations, limitations, and customs inspection procedures for international mail, parcels, samples, and prints sent to and from Japan.
subfiles.from: General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Outlines rules, weight limits, prohibited matter, and licensing requirements for international letters, commercial papers, samples, and parcel post to Japan.
subfiles.title: Regulations Concerning International Postal Service (Appendix IV)
